audit_metadata.scope: Source-level consistency review of the 16 frozen zoxide records. No prediction/result files or other audit judgments were read.
audit_metadata.review_status: LLM source review; not compiler-origin-ID proof and not independent human validation

inputs.profile: O3, 16 codegen units, no LTO, debuginfo=0, panic=unwind

audit_metadata.address_note: Each FUN_ identifier retains the frozen Ghidra address. Matching ELF symbols occur at that hexadecimal address minus the 0x100000 Ghidra image base.
audit_metadata.checksum_note: The unpacked registry directories do not contain .cargo-checksum.json. Where a .crate archive was locally available, its SHA-256 was checked against Cargo.lock, or against the rustc sysroot library Cargo.lock for addr2line/object. All such package checks matched. Individual source-file SHA-256 values are recorded below.

strongest_potential_label_problem.finding: The normalized name parse_line::{{closure}} collapses three distinct lexical closure definitions at source lines 42, 45, and 48. The ELF contains three different symbols, hashes, sizes, and behaviors corresponding one-to-one to those sites. Treating all three as one positive source-origin group conflicts with the source.
